first_block.first_paragraph: La Burie is a grand and charming manor house from the 19th century, carefully renovated and decorated with a mix of vintage, family, and contemporary furniture.
first_block.second_paragraph: The guest rooms consist of two beautiful, brand-new suites on the second floor under the eaves, and a family suite on the first floor.
first_block.third_paragraph: The property is located just outside the village of Saint-Savinien, 1.5 km from the center.

second_block.first_paragraph: The guesthouse offers two spacious double rooms on the second floor, located under the roof, as well as a large family suite on the first floor that can accommodate up to six people.

first_card.title: Breakfast crafted with love
first_card.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast made with care, featuring local and seasonal products, fresh bread, homemade yogurt, and jams.

second_card.title: Restful sleep
second_card.description: Enjoy an unparalleled night’s sleep with our premium high-quality cotton sheets. They ensure optimal comfort for a restful night.

third_card.title: Serenity in the garden
third_card.description: Discover numerous relaxing spots throughout the garden. Sunny or shaded terraces, perfect for outdoor meals or moments of reading.
